name: @ausm/device-macos-screen-stream
description: macOS screen capture (ScreenCaptureKit) helper that streams BGRA frames to POSIX shared memory, with a Node client and a Python reader

scripts.build: npm run sync-python && npm run build:helper && tsup
scripts.sync-python: rm -rf python && mkdir -p python/screen-stream-reader/screen_stream_reader && cp ../internal-lib/screen-stream-reader/pyproject.toml ../internal-lib/screen-stream-reader/requirements.txt ../internal-lib/screen-stream-reader/README.md python/screen-stream-reader/ && cp ../internal-lib/screen-stream-reader/screen_stream_reader/*.py python/screen-stream-reader/screen_stream_reader/
scripts.build:helper: cd swift && swift build -c release --arch arm64 --arch x86_64 && mkdir -p ../build && cp "$(swift build -c release --arch arm64 --arch x86_64 --show-bin-path)/ScreenCaptureHelper" ../build/screen-capture-helper && codesign --force --sign "${SIGN_IDENTITY:--}" --identifier "com.ausm.screen-capture-helper" ../build/screen-capture-helper
scripts.test: npm run test:swift && npm run test:python
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist build python && cd swift && swift package clean

author: Timeless
